column1: # Free-form noul questions about live speech (docs/laya-audio.md, "Free-form questions").
# family_split: train   = asked in distillation training;
#               heldout = never asked in training (generalisation to new question families);
#               para    = paralinguistic, never trained (tone, not words: a transcript teacher cannot teach it).
# phrasing_split: in train families, one phrasing per family is held out (never asked in training).
# real_label_rule (optional): where a real label exists.
#   tag:A|B|C     a labelled span with any of these tags lies (mostly) in the window; a trailing * matches a prefix.
#                 Only evaluated on sets whose label file uses that tag namespace (the part before '=').
#   subset:A|B    the utterance's corpus subset starts with A or B (a domain proxy, pooled across sets).
